description: Khối lượng cổ phiếu sở hữu nhà nước (K_GSDC_1389)
etl_logic: (SELECT SUM(sc.owned_share_quantity) FROM pc_state_capital sc JOIN public_company pcm ON pcm.pc_code = sc.pc_code WHERE pcm.equity_ticker_symbol = listed_security_info_snapshot.ticker_symbol AND sc.deleted_ind <> 1 AND sc.src_stm_code = 'IDS_STATE_CAPITAL' AND sc.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM pc_state_capital sc2 WHERE YEAR(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) = YEAR(listed_security_info_snapshot.ds_snpst_dt) AND MONTH(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) = MONTH(listed_security_info_snapshot.ds_snpst_dt)))
